questions.stem: What is electric current defined as?

options.text: The total amount of charge in a circuit
The rate of flow of electric charge
The speed at which electrons travel through a wire
The force that pushes electrons around a circuit

questions.explanation: Electric current is defined as the rate of flow of electric charge past a point in a circuit. It is measured in amperes (A), where 1 A = 1 coulomb of charge flowing per second.
